tutorial.title: Tabs keep running
tutorial.body: Each tab stays alive until you close it. Start a long job, switch panels or close the window, and it keeps going.

tutorial.title: Save the commands you repeat
tutorial.body: Save a command once and run it from the tab bar, or pin it to Home to run it in one click.

tutorial.title: Bring any tool
tutorial.body: If it runs in a terminal it runs here, colors and all. Even the weather forecast.
